Insulator should be rigid and very good insulation. Insulator should be tested at 2 Kv RMS AC, 50Hz, d uration of 2 Minutes; 2. Test Certificate of high voltage of Dry & Wet test to be done. 3. T-Bar Should be coated by Smoke-Gray paint all over Except Friction Area; 6. Tolerance of T-Bar should be (+20mm / -0.0000mm). 7. Party will deliver the material mentioned in drawing.
